name: Palmer Penguins
description: Three penguin species with body measurements, islands, sex, years, and missing values.

license.name: CC0 1.0
license.attribution: Horst AM, Hill AP, Gorman KB (2020). palmerpenguins: Palmer Archipelago (Antarctica) penguin data. doi:10.5281/zenodo.3960218.

learning_goals: Explore multiclass confusion matrices and weighted metrics.
Visualize morphology by species and island.
Compare simple linear boundaries with nonlinear ensembles.
ethical_notes: Ecological observations cover specific species, islands, and study years; do not extrapolate beyond that sampling context without domain review.
